target: Teach another learner to reason about generalization using a train-test gap study. Fix a time, memory and energy budget before the run.

competency.title: Teach generalization — compute budget
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about generalization using a train-test gap study. Fix a time, memory and energy budget before the run.
competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in a train-test gap study.
competency.setting_constraint: Fix a time, memory and energy budget before the run.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include resource log and quality per unit of compute.
Report out-of-distribution error with uncertainty interval with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: tuning on the test partition.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of generalization.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report out-of-distribution error with uncertainty interval against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for tuning on the test partition; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
